original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

first_step.inspect: Locate the selected packing source in the review and check live PRs for the same residual problem.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

existing_checks.scope: Packing-independent ceiling for the selected paid profile under the one-unpaid-coordinate coverage and halving guard.
existing_checks.remaining: A changed word or model requires new pricing; a local packing search must name uncovered scope.

actual_scope: PR3015's R1 words (PR2979's words plus Jeremy Kothe's declared restore edit R1) with a literal T740 allocation attaining their fixed-capacity packing cap: ten lockstep copies of PR2979's literal T74 fill (used unchanged by PR3015; PR2969's lift convention) plus 332 explicit whole-role relocations along same-width exchange chains, putting the pattern mix on an integral point of the optimal face.
scope_change_reason: The card targets the selected record's packing, whose ceiling is already reviewed. The live open question is the newest candidate's integrality gap: PR3015/PR3021 release R1 at T74, 1.78e-9/1.55e-9 below R1's certified cap, and the optimal face needs 20 | T. Bounded, packing-only composition with PR3015's declared edit, reported against the exact R1 cap (attained).
bottleneck_link: Packing only: the paid local profile is PR3015's, so the gain is capped by R1's fixed-capacity relaxation; this attains it (+1.552e-9 over PR3021's released headline, +1.782e-9 over PR3015). It closes the packing layer for these words.
stop_rule: Publish only if the R1 words re-derive the providers, PR2979's owner engine accepts the literal T740 allocation with the claimed complete profile, the idle histogram is exactly 740 x the optimal basic idle profile (root = R1 cap), and the re-pinned moment auditor shows a strict gain over PR3015 with an exact strict gain over PR3021; otherwise stop.
evidence: verify.py (stdlib, about 70 s): live PR2979 input pins and vendored PR3015/PR3021 pins (heads, Git blobs, SHA-256); providers re-derived from the R1 words (PR2979 widths, R1 local profile, 91 buffers); deterministic T740 rebuild with pinned canonical payload SHA-256; owner engine over 2,717,280 roles; physical 663,549; R1 cap certificate re-verified; exact fixed face counts (20 | T); idle = 740 x basic optimum; all bin patterns tight; root bracket = R1 cap bracket; moment auditor re-pinned to PR3015 (strict gain); exact strict gain over PR3021. controls.py (stdlib, about 4 min): seven controls rejected or losing the gain.
